title: 🤝 Mesa AZ Community & Social Services Roles with Multiple Openings - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago Mesa is busy hiring in community and social services right now. If you like helping people live better, there are several solid full-time options open.
Caregiver – Group Home (Full-Time) Employer: Sevita (Mentor Community Services) Location: Mesa, AZ – near E. Southern Ave & S. Higley Rd ( 85206 ) Salary: Starting at $15.15/hr Type: Full-time
This role supports adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities in a group home setting. You’ll help with daily living, personal care, and community activities, with full benefits , 401(k) with 3% match , PTO, and training to grow your caregiving career. Employment Specialist II Employer: Copa Health Location: Mesa, AZ Salary: Starting at $19/hr DOE Type: Full-time
Help adults with behavioral health needs find and keep jobs in the community . This role blends case management and job coaching, with a caseload of about 25+ members and strong benefits like medical, dental, vision, 403(b) match, up to 3 weeks PTO in year one, 10 holidays, wellness programs, and tuition reimbursement up to $3,000 .
